subject: Re: POC Sponsorship & per-token tiering for Neoteric Health
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@neoterichealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@neoterichealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC credits + per-token tiers — can we get a proposal?

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Neoteric liked the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to get a clear written proposal on two things before we move to legal: (1) pilot sponsorship (free credits) you can provide for a 60–90 day evaluation, and (2) the per-token pricing ladder you would offer if we convert to a paid commit.

Couple specific asks from my side:
- Can the pilot credits cover our expected 90-day test footprint (~350k tokens total)?
- Do you have a minimum commit for discounts, and how do overages get billed?
- Procurement will want SOC2 evidence and basic data residency notes.

If you can send a short templated offer we can route to Priya for procurement review.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Director of Product
Neoteric Health

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@neoterichealth.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@neoterichealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC credits + per-token tiers — draft offer attached

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Appreciate the clarity — please find a concise offer below and an attached pricing grid and SOW for the POC. [Attachment: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx (xlsx)] [Attachment: poc-sow.pdf (pdf)]

Summary — Pilot & Convert Path (high level):
- Pilot sponsorship: 30,000 free credits applied to hosted API usage for a 60-day POC (covers ~300k tokens at baseline model).
- Convert option: if you sign a commit within 21 days after POC, pilot credits roll into committed credits (no double-billing).
- Commit tiers (per-token discount off list price):
  - Tier 1: 200k tokens/month commit (3-month minimum) -> 10% per-token discount
  - Tier 2: 1M tokens/month commit (12-month) -> 18% per-token discount
  - Volume step-downs: incremental discounts apply as usage bands are hit; overages billed at list price unless contracted as auto-batch.
- Launch incentive: we can offer a one-time bonus credit on top of pilot credits for a signed launch plan (amount negotiable).
- Security/compliance: SOC2 report available; we can provide a redacted attestation and typical data handling notes.

Next steps I propose: we can run the 60-day pilot with the 30k credit while I loop in Marcus (SE) for a short perf workshop and Laura (finance) to pre-clear discount flexibility. If procurement needs lower minimums, flag that and I will escalate.

If that sounds reasonable I will send a clean proposal and a DocuSign for signature.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx]

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@neoterichealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@neoterichealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC credits + per-token tiers — a few follow-ups

Thanks Rachel — couple of clarifications before we show this to procurement: 
- 30k credits looks light vs our estimate (350k tokens). Can you make the pilot cover the full expected 90-day footprint or at least 75%?
- Can you provide a softened minimum commit option (e.g., 6 months at a lower per-month token minimum) — our internal procurement is averse to 12-month lock-ins.
- How do pilot credits convert if we elect not to continue — any refund/credit policy?

Procurement specifically will ask for: SOC2 link, master services terms, and a sample invoice schedule. If you can include those in the next email that will speed things up.

—Sanjay

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@neoterichealth.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@neoterichealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 19:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: POC credits + per-token tiers — internal ask

Team — forwarding Neoteric's clarification. Quick suggested path:
- Increase pilot sponsorship to 45k credits to cover ~80–90% of their 90-day test footprint.
- Offer a 6-month soft-commit alternative: 200k tokens/month for 6 months at a 15% per-token discount (auto-convert from pilot if they sign).
- Offer a one-time launch bonus of 15k credits if they sign within 21 days post-POC and agree to a joint launch plan (marketing/press optional).

Marcus: can you prepare a short perf/latency memo showing expected cost at 200k/month and the model family we'd use?
Laura: can you confirm finance okay with the 15% discount for a 6-month commitment and provide invoicing terms (Net 30/Net 60)? I attached a draft proposal for legal and contracts to review. [Attachment: proposal-draft.pdf]

HubSpot: ND-4521
DocuSign draft ready pending approvals.

—Rachel

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC credits + per-token tiers — finance ack

Rachel / Marcus,

Finance is okay to provisionally approve the modified structure with these controls:
- Approve pilot bump to 45k credits.
- Approve a 6-month soft-commit at 200k tokens/month with a 15% per-token discount (margin gated — limited to 1 strategic account exception).
- If customer signs the full 12-month we can migrate to 18% discount but need legal to sign off on auto-conversion clauses.
- Invoicing: Net 30 standard. If procurement insists on Net 60, run an AR risk review.
- Launch bonus (15k credits) ok if marketing/legal sign off on co-marketing collateral.

Please flag if procurement requires refunds for unused pilot credits — standard policy is no refunds but credits can be carried into committed usage if contract executed.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@neoterichealth.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@neoterichealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final offer: POC sponsorship, 6-month soft-commit & launch bonus

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks for the patience. Per internal approvals here is the final offer we can sign to start the POC immediately:

Final offer (summary):
- Pilot sponsorship: 45,000 free credits for a 60-day POC (expected to cover ~80–90% of your 90-day volume).
- Soft-commit conversion: if you sign within 21 days after the POC, pilot credits convert and we will enact a 6-month commitment at 200k tokens/month at a 15% per-token discount.
- Launch bonus: additional one-time 15,000 credits if Neoteric signs and commits to a joint launch plan within 21 days.
- Billing & terms: Standard Master Services Agreement applies; invoicing Net 30. SOC2 report and redacted security attestation: https://redwoodinference.share/docs/soc2-report.pdf
- DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-id
- HubSpot deal: ND-4521

If this aligns with your procurement needs we can: (a) kick off the POC this week, (b) schedule a 60–90 minute perf/runbook session with Marcus, and (c) send the DocuSign.

Would you like me to revise the SOW to explicitly include data handling/residency notes for your legal team?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
